decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, Block Plan, Design and Access Statement, SO/01, and Flood Map for Planning received: 23/05/2018. TP/01 Rev A received: 04/07/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the structure hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 4 Strand on the Green. For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen, or as a separate unit of accommodation.
description: Erection of a single storey detached garage and workspace, removal of apple tree, and widening of vehicular access to the rear of the house.
